title: The recorded promotion predicate picks the newest row per context and misses an older row the ruleset still blocks on
description: Measured 2026-09-24 promoting b66ca56 (PR #241). The CLAUDE.md required-set predicate (group_by name, max_by started_at) returned success for all three required contexts. git push origin origin/dev:main was then rejected with GH013: Required status check "Tracker integrity" is queued. There were two Tracker integrity rows on the SHA: the pull_request row (run 35957412371, started 04:51:22Z) had succeeded, and the push row from the squash into dev (run 35957399096, started 04:51:07Z) was still queued. The predicate saw only the newer one. The ruleset blocked on the older, unfinished one. It failed safe (main did not move, and the API ref read confirmed it), and the push landed after that row completed at 04:56:26Z. A queued row did not stay put in the newest-first order: its started_at moved to 04:56:10Z when it ran.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The CLAUDE.md predicate additionally requires that no row for a required context is still pending, and states the measured rejection it prevents
The correction is marked as a correction, with how it got in

finalSummary:
The promotion predicate in the CLAUDE.md profile now also requires that no row of a required context is still pending, and it records the GH013 rejection that showed the gap.

What happened: PR #241 promoting b66ca56. The newest-per-context predicate cleared all three contexts, but GitHub rejected the push: an older Tracker integrity push row, run 35957399096, was still queued behind a newer pull_request row that had passed. The push landed after that row completed. The failure was safe; the ref read confirmed main had not moved.

The first draft of the added line used `gh api --jq` with --argjson, which gh rejects with "accepts 1 arg(s)". Caught by running it, and switched to piping into jq.

Proven on the same SHA, while the post-promotion push-to-main source-gates run was in flight: the check returned false while that row was in_progress, and true at 04:59:24Z once it completed.

Left unmeasured and said so in the text: what an older FAILED row does once a newer row has passed.
